corrections.reason: The seasonal state enters the measurement undamped: the common seasonal case of the same table has W_3 = 1_n and the individual level W_1 = I_n; the damping matrix belongs to the trend.
A is the n by n block G_1 of an individual level; the paper's own example in Section 4.1 has G_1 = \alpha I_2, and \Phi = \phi I_n in the same table.
B is the n by n block G_2 of an individual trend; the paper's own example in Section 4.1 has G_2 = \beta I_2.
\Gamma is the n by n block G_3 of an individual seasonal component, as A and B are for level and trend.
